patterns.note: Asymmetrical vertical text labels are used on the left side of the viewport to introduce sections or provide decorative context.
Prominent use of circular shapes for interactive elements (footer links, testimonial cards) and content framing, creating a playful and distinct visual rhythm.
A highly distinctive, custom, blob-like display typeface is used for the brand logo and key headings, conveying a unique and playful personality.
High-contrast color blocking is employed with a dominant rust-brown, black, and a vibrant, soft lime green to delineate sections and create visual interest.
The large, custom 'touchy coffee' logo in the hero section scales down and moves upwards, disappearing as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic parallax-like introduction.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header navigation that remains visible at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to key links.
Create a hero section where a large, custom-designed logo scales down and translates upwards out of view as the user scrolls, revealing the content below with a sense of depth.
Utilize vertical text orientation for section labels or decorative elements, positioned on the page's left margin to add an unconventional visual accent.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, custom display font for the brand identity (~5-6x body text) paired with a consistent, smaller monospaced-like font for all other content and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners for most elements and cards, with a strong contrast provided by perfectly circular elements for navigation and interactive links.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy and spacious, particularly in the hero and main descriptive text sections, creating a relaxed and unhurried feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, custom, blob-like display typeface for the brand logo and main headings, which immediately conveys a playful and unique personality. This, combined with the unconventional use of vertical text and circular interactive elements, creates a memorable and quirky brand identity that stands apart from typical coffee e-commerce sites.
